You are restyling a React page to a new DARK "black & blue" design system. WRITE CODE. Do NOT run npm build (orchestrator verifies). Do NOT change any business logic, handlers, API calls, state, socket events, or component structure. Only rewrite className/markup for styling, move static inline styles to classes, and add design-state components (empty/loading).

FIRST read the design-system file at "/Users/rayhan/Desktop/Code projects/Openglimpse/src/client/src/index.css". Use ONLY classes defined there plus standard Tailwind utilities (flex, gap-*, p-*, m-*, w-*, h-*, text-*, bg-*, border-*, rounded-*, sm:/md:/lg: suffixes, min-w-0, truncate, capitalize, etc.). Custom color utilities: bg-bg, bg-surface, bg-surface-2, text-ink, text-muted, text-accent, text-ok, text-bad, text-warn, border-edge, bg-accent, bg-accent-deep, bg-ok-dim, bg-bad-dim, bg-warn-dim + opacity modifiers (bg-surface/85, bg-accent/15).

DESIGN LANGUAGE:
- Dark theme. Root: <main className="page">. Body bg #0b0d10. Cards bg-surface #171a1f. Elevated bg-surface-2 #1e232b.
- Accent blue #3b82f6. Present/live green (text-ok/bg-ok-dim). Missing/warn amber (text-warn/bg-warn-dim). Error red (text-bad).
- Header: <header className="topbar"> with .back-btn (MUI ArrowBack or left-arrow via text) + .page-title "Directory" + a .pill-neutral or segmented programme picker in .header-actions.
- Search box: .search-box with .search-icon, .search-input, .search-clear.
- Filter chips: .filter-chip + .filter-chip-active.
- Rows: .row .row-clickable, .row-left, avatar .avatar .avatar-md + .avatar-ok (present) / .avatar-warn (missing), .row-text, .row-title, .row-meta.
- Action buttons: "btn btn-sm btn-secondary" for route assign; in assign mode use a .select for route + .btn btn-sm btn-primary (Save) and .btn btn-sm btn-ghost (Cancel).
- Empty state: import EmptyState from '../../components/shared/EmptyState'; use icon={<MuiIcon/>}, title "No delegates found", desc. Loading: .skeleton rows or .skeleton-text.
- Error banner: <div className="banner banner-error">. 
- Profile bottom sheet (on row click): use sheet classes: .sheet-backdrop > .sheet > .sheet-handle, .sheet-header (.sheet-title name + .sheet-sub status), .sheet-body with detail rows (label .meta + value .title) and a present/absent .pill, .sheet-footer optional. Keep close on backdrop/Escape.
- Programme picker dropdown: style as a dark popover (bg-surface-2 border-edge rounded-xl) with items .row-clickable; active item text-accent bg-accent/10.
- Icons: keep @mui/icons-material. Remove ALL sx={{...}} props; do not size icons inline (inherit text size or use .btn-icon/.back-btn svg classes).
- Comments: short plain labels only, NO em dashes.
- Mobile-first (~390px); use lg: to widen max width for desktop only.
- Fix the existing inline style on the Route button (style={{background..., color...}}) by replacing with proper classes.

/Users/rayhan/Desktop/Code projects/Openglimpse/src/client/src/pages/directory/directory.jsx
